entries.question: I lost my progress or items
entries.answer:
Your data may take a moment to load after joining. Rejoin the game once and wait on the lobby screen for a few seconds before checking again.

If it's still missing after rejoining, open a ticket and include your **Roblox username** and **roughly when you last saw it**.

entries.question: I bought something but didn't get it
entries.answer:
Purchases sometimes take a few minutes to go through. Rejoin the game and check again.

If you still don't have it, open a ticket with your **Roblox username**, **what you bought**, and **when**. A screenshot of your Robux transaction history helps a lot.

entries.question: How do I report a bug?
entries.answer: Bugs go in the bug reports forum, not tickets. Please read the pinned guidelines there before posting so the team can reproduce it.

entries.question: When is the next update?
entries.answer: We don't give out update dates ahead of time. Keep an eye on the announcements channel!
